tests.procedure: Loss on drying: weigh an empty weighing bottle previously dried at 105 °C and cooled in desiccator (W0); weigh accurately 1.000 g (W1); dry in a calibrated oven at 105 °C for 2 h, cool in desiccator, weigh (W2); repeat to constant weight. % = (W1 - W2) / (W1 - W0) x 100. Limit NMT 8.0%.

details.drying: calibrated oven 105 °C, 2 h, then to constant weight
details.reference: USP <731>; Analytical Method Verification Report for loss on drying in Natural Beta carotene 20 %

tests.procedure: Heavy metals as lead by AAS: standards from 1000 ppm lead standard (1 mL to 100 mL, then 5, 7.5, 10 and 12.5 mL each to 100 mL) giving 0.5, 0.75, 1.0 and 1.25 ppm; calibration curve. Sample: 1 g with 10 mL conc. HCl and 10 mL distilled water, boil 5 min, transfer to 100 mL flask, cool, make up with distilled water, filter. Blank with distilled water, read standards from low to high, then sample. Wavelength 283.31 nm, lead hollow-cathode lamp, air-acetylene flame. Limit NMT 2 ppm.

details.digestion: 10 mL conc. HCl + 10 mL distilled water, boil 5 min
details.standardPreparation: 1 mL of 1000 ppm lead standard to 100 mL; 5, 7.5, 10, 12.5 mL of that to 100 mL each
details.reference: Analytical Method Verification Report for Heavy Metals in Natural Beta carotene 20 %

tests.procedure: Arsenic by AAS: standards from 1000 ppm arsenic standard (2 mL to 200 mL, then 10, 20, 30, 40 mL each to 100 mL) giving 1, 2, 3 and 4 ppm; calibration curve. Blank with distilled water, read standards low to high, then sample. Wavelength 193.07 nm, arsenic hollow-cathode lamp, air-acetylene flame. Limit NMT 3 ppm.

tests.procedure: Assay (UV, spectrophotometric): weigh about 350 mg sample into a 50 mL volumetric flask, add distilled water and disperse (ultrasonic bath if needed), make up to 50 mL. Take 1 mL and dilute to 100 mL with acetone; from this prepare a 5 in 50 dilution with acetone (final dilution factor 50000). Read absorbance at 456 nm and 800 nm against acetone. % beta-carotene = (A456 - A800) x 50000 / (2500 x W), W = sample weight (g), 2500 = A1% 1 cm of beta-carotene in acetone. Limit NLT 20%.

details.dispersion: 50 mL distilled water, ultrasonic bath if needed
details.reference: USP <857>; Analytical Method Validation Report for Content of Natural Beta carotene 20 % (Doc C6R-72-208)
